messages:
Mohit: AM quick pulse — GPU fleet / prewarm check.

Mohit: What I did: ran a spot-drain simulation for eu-west-2 to validate the rebalancer; executed node-rebalance v2 script and verified steady-state shift. Observed headroom drop 12 -> 8 after draining older spot pods. Rolled a small autoscaler tweak (maxBurst=3) to reduce churn.

Mohit: Blockers: p4d quota increase in eu-west-2b is stuck — AWS console shows "quota request pending" for 24h, support portal not responding. This blocks the canary rollout which needs +8 p4d capacity.

Mohit: Today / ask: need someone from cloud-ops to escalate the quota or give permission to route prewarm to a10g / g5 fallback in eu-west-2c. If quota isn't resolved by 11:30 UTC, I plan to switch prewarm mapping to fallback region (ap-southeast-1) for the canary.

Alyssa: Filed CLOUD-783 in our internal tracker and added the spike graphs + justification. Also opened an AWS support escalation (P2) and added account-level contact. :eyes:

Alyssa: FWIW, routing to a10g for short prompt lengths looks fine perf-wise — recommend as temporary fallback.

Samir: Looked at the autoscaler policy: two safe knobs — reduce min_instances to 4 to free immediate headroom, and lower target_utilization 0.7 -> 0.6 to avoid long warmup tails. I can push a short-lived config patch in ~10m.

Tara: I'll prep a small infra PR to prefer a10g/g5 for eu-west-2 prewarm mapping and add a runtime flag to toggle fallback. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4567 — needs one reviewer + deploy-owner approval.

deploy-bot: scheduler: auto-reshuffle started — 4 prewarm jobs moved to ap-southeast-1 as fallback (job ids: job-2194, job-2201, job-2202, job-2205).

Mohit: If anyone can run the quota bump command directly, here's the CLI we used locally (replace quota-code with the p4d quota id):
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase \
  --service-code ec2 \
  --quota-code L-12345 \
  --desired-value 40 \
  --region eu-west-2
```

Mohit: One more note — our prewarm reclaim window is 3h; during surge I propose shrinking it to 90m to free capacity faster. I'll open a short RFC / change ticket after the quota situation.

Alyssa: ACK. I'll keep pushing CLOUD-783 and will approve Tara's PR once the runtime flag is present. Samir — please hold the config change until we merge the PR to keep the rollout coordinated. :thumbsup:
